description:
Twinkle Twinkle Little Star! — Twinkle twinkle little star... wait, did you know real stars are NOT pointy at all?
Kids science answer for "twinkle twinkle little star for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Stars look tiny and pointy because they are trillions of miles away, but each star is actually a giant glowing ball of super hot gas, just like our sun. When starlight passes through Earth's atmosphere, the moving air bends the light, making it twinkle.
